artifacts.summary: 6-phase, 8-hour plan across three independent scopes (opencode spam/policy, picker entry honesty, Global Update) with disjoint per-phase file sets and four recorded design decisions.

memory_candidates.content: In the nvim extension system (lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/), manager.resync_all loops manager.load(..., {force = true}) once per loaded extension, and manager.load calls merge_mod.generate_opencode_json once per invocation. Any notification emitted inside generate_opencode_json therefore fires once PER EXTENSION during a single <leader>al bulk reload, not once per reload. De-duplicating or summarising such a notification must happen at the resync_all caller level (accumulate across the loop, emit once after it); collapsing to 'one summary per generate_opencode_json invocation' does not reduce the message count at all. The same applies to generate_claudemd, which sits on the identical per-extension path.
